title.en: Ibadan in indigo and maker marks

before.en:
A small scorpion-like mark on a cloth's hem can preserve authorship even when a name has been lost. Two hand-painted àdìrẹ cloths collected in Ibadan in the 1960s carry such a signature. Women painted cassava-starch resist onto cotton before indigo dyeing, leaving pale designs when the protected areas were revealed. Other makers tied or stitched the cloth to resist the dye.

Patterns responded to the city and to customers. One celebrated Ibadan through the columns of Mapo Hall; another design was described to collectors as the fashionable cloth of 1964. Imported factory cotton became a material for local invention. These textiles connect Nigeria's political milestones to working knowledge, changing taste and women's businesses. The signature invites recognition of a maker without supplying a name that the collection cannot establish.
before.zh:
衣边一个像蝎子的标记，即使姓名失传，也可能保存作者身份。二十世纪六十年代在伊巴丹购藏的两件手绘阿迪雷布，带有这样的署名。女子在棉布上涂木薯淀粉防染，再浸入靛蓝，受到保护的部分形成浅色纹样。其他制作者则通过扎结或缝缀防染。

图案回应城市生活与顾客需求。一种用马波市政厅的柱子歌咏伊巴丹；另一种被当地卖家称为1964年的流行布样。进口机制棉布成为本地创新的材料。这些织物把尼日利亚的政治节点与实作知识、品味变化及女子经营联系起来。署名让人看到制作者，却不能补出馆藏尚未确定的姓名。

after.en:
A small scorpion-like mark on a cloth's hem can preserve authorship even when a name has been lost. Two hand-painted àdìrẹ cloths collected in Ibadan in the 1960s carry such a signature. Women painted cassava-starch resist onto cotton before indigo dyeing, leaving pale designs when the protected areas were revealed. Other makers tied or stitched the cloth to resist the dye.

Patterns responded to the city and to customers. One celebrated Ibadan through the columns of Mapo Hall; another design was described to collectors as the fashionable cloth of 1964. Imported factory cotton became a material for local invention. These textiles connect Nigeria's political milestones to working knowledge, changing taste and women's businesses. The signature invites recognition of a maker without supplying a name that the collection cannot establish.

A separate wrapper at Princeton, dated around 1960, offers another example of the Ibadan design. Its patterned squares include Mapo Hall, while its border bears two maker marks. The museum leaves open whether two women painted it. Comparing the cloths brings individual signatures and variations within a shared design into view.
after.zh:
衣边一个像蝎子的标记，即使姓名失传，也可能保存作者身份。二十世纪六十年代在伊巴丹购藏的两件手绘阿迪雷布，带有这样的署名。女子在棉布上涂木薯淀粉防染，再浸入靛蓝，受到保护的部分形成浅色纹样。其他制作者则通过扎结或缝缀防染。

图案回应城市生活与顾客需求。一种用马波市政厅的柱子歌咏伊巴丹；另一种被当地卖家称为1964年的流行布样。进口机制棉布成为本地创新的材料。这些织物把尼日利亚的政治节点与实作知识、品味变化及女子经营联系起来。署名让人看到制作者，却不能补出馆藏尚未确定的姓名。

普林斯顿收藏的另一件约1960年围布，提供了伊巴丹图案的不同实例。其花纹方格包括马波市政厅，边缘带有两个制作者标记。馆方尚未确定是否由两位女子绘制。对照这些布样，可以看到共有设计中的个人署名与变化。

accessRecord:
# Batch 17: one useful Ibadan cloth, other candidates held

Stable research-only subset. No production edits, Git, Actions or deployment.

## Accepted for owner review
Princeton University Art Museum 2018-129, object 135166, c.1960 àdìrẹ ẹlé̩kọ wrapper → ibadan-adire-signatures-markets. The institutional description identifies the Ibadan/Mapo Hall pattern and two maker marks, without asserting two makers as fact. This is a distinct cloth from the V&A cloths already in the entry; the caption and proposed paragraph say so explicitly. No invented maker identity or scorpion-mark attribution.

The exact official item download dialog identifies the offered image as public-domain, and supplies Medium (1024px) and maximum-size downloads. Its linked institutional image policy states downloadable public-domain images may be used without seeking approval; restricted works cannot be downloaded. Those two pages were successfully read with the web reader. The official IIIF manifest corroborates exact object identity, date, material, description and attribution. It does not independently provide a rights URI. Item-specific download declaration plus linked policy are the rights evidence, not a generic site footer or a guess from age.

Official unchanged 1024 × 973 JPEG: 271,864 bytes. Pixel review confirmed blue patterned squares, central seam, cloth edges and column motifs. Border marks are identified by the source, not decoded from this overview. Source and image IDs were searched in current media records with zero existing matches. Validation: 978 illustrated entries / 539 assets baseline, zero errors, zero stale before-summary values, one new target. Potential 979 / 540.

Source proposal is separate from summary edits. Preserve existing V&A sources and add/deduplicate the exact Princeton object source.

## Access outcomes
A later optional attempt to save raw HTML copies of the successfully web-read Princeton item and rights pages returned HTTP 403. Those exact requests were not retried, and no alternate raw-HTML route was attempted. The separately preplanned official IIIF manifest and directly offered 1024px image downloads succeeded. The image URL was taken directly from the item page, not inferred to bypass a denied asset route. No image access denial occurred.

## Held / not acquired
- Met 318968 Okeseni adire, 310780 Konomani and 690570 lukasa: exact pages explicitly prohibit download. No image/API follow-up.
- Kimbell ap-199404 Ife and ap-199603 Nok: exact pages returned 403. No alternate routes.
- Oberlin 37935 lukasa: downloadable image listed but no item-level open reuse license established. No image acquired.
- LACMA 15378 Ardabil Carpet: current exact page credits photograph copyright to Museum Associates/LACMA, without an open image declaration. No image acquired; did not rely on older third-party claims.
- Smithsonian Libraries holycarpetmosqu00steb: OCIO request-rejected page. No retry/alternate route.
- Princeton 34028 ikat fragment: attributed to Turkey, not Ferghana. Rejected as a weak geographical match; no image acquired.
- Met 39378 Ayutthaya plaque: open image but sparse item context did not justify adding an arbitrary object to a broad kingdom story. No image acquired.
- Yale recipe-tablet and Onfim searches did not establish a new permitted institutional image route; Commons routes remain stopped.

Returning one meaningful image rather than padding to four. All earlier stopped routes and batch16 HOLD remain in force. Stop here pending owner review.
